# Round-3 tables (generated by run_v3.py; do not edit)

Reflectance: R_on/R_off = 0.463/0.342, MEASURED at 635 nm (paper Fig. S11). At 780 and 850 nm the same value is EXTRAPOLATED (optimistic); x0.5 / x0.25 rows assume the true swing there is half / a quarter of it (same mean R). Tissue mu_s' values are quoted at 780 nm and scaled to other wavelengths with b = 1.286. Read = decode ID + value, round-2 calibrated rule (SNR/cycle x sqrt(cycles/bit) >= 23, or 120 beyond 500 um). 10 mW/cm2, mu_a 0.02/mm unless stated.

## 3a. How flat must a chip on the dish be? (SPOT facing the glass, no tissue in the path)

Tilt limit = largest tilt that still decodes within 60 s (round-2 tilt runs); optics-only limit = 0.5*asin(2 NA / n) where the reflected cone leaves the lens entirely. Largest particle height h = side x tan(limit).

| plate20MP_NA0.05 | 0.05 | 2.02 deg | 2.16 deg | 5.3 um | 7.1 um | 10.6 um | 1.9 / 1.0 deg: OK |
